text:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to close postmortem follow-ups from the DB outage. Owners, dates, and a simple tracker.

Jose: Agreed. Replica lag is a recurring pattern; a few actions are still open and unowned. I'll pull the list.

Riley: I can sketch a minimal timeline template. Fields: Action / Owner / Due / Verify steps / Recurrence. Short and repeatable. Example:
```
- Action: Rotate replica config
  Owner: @anita
  Due: 2025-11-06
  Verify: smoke tests + 24h stability
  Recurrence: quarterly
```

Anita: Taking replica config rotation. Ill add a checklist & runbook link when done. Target next Wed (2025-11-06). :white_check_mark: 

Tom: We had a gap in IC handoff during the outage. Need a lightweight IC rotation + handoff template so there's no ambiguity.

Lina: I can propose the rotation rules. Suggest 2-week IC terms, explicit Slack handoff message, and quarterly coverage review. Also propose a standing 10-min follow-up on Tuesdays to review open PM actions. :calendar: 

Maya: For tracking: one Google Sheet + a recurring Slack reminder. Columns: action, owner, created_ts, due_ts, status, verification_notes, recurrence_flag, incident_pattern. Jose, can you consolidate open items?

Jose: On it. Will map current open actions to owners today and post the sheet link. I'll tag owners and suggest due dates. :eyes: 

Riley: Add a timeline template tab in the sheet and an "incident pattern" column to flag categories (replication, deploy, infra). That will help spot repeats over time.

Anita: Will include exact verification commands in the runbook and link it in the sheet once complete.

incident-bot: Reminder: 3 open postmortem actions assigned (due within 7 days). Reply `ack` to snooze.

Tom: Comms cadence proposal: during incidents - initial ack <= 5m, hourly status updates until resolved, final postmortem note within 48h. For remediation follow-ups: owners update status weekly until closed.

Lina: Draft IC handoff template below:
```
IC Handoff
- Outgoing: brief summary, in-flight actions, who you're handing to
- Incoming: ack + immediate priorities
- Slack tag: @incident-channel @escalation
- Handoff time: timestamp + timezone
```

Maya: Action items from thread:
- Jose: consolidate open actions into tracker by EOD (due 2025-10-31)
- Anita: rotate replica config + post runbook (due 2025-11-06)
- Lina: draft IC rotation rules, handoff template, comms cadence doc (due 2025-11-03)
- Riley: add incident pattern column & timeline template to sheet (due 2025-11-01)

Jose: Acknowledged. Will DM owners for acceptance and post the sheet link here.

Maya: We'll review the tracker in next Tuesday's 10-min slot. If anyone has blockers, ping here. :thumbsup:
